body: Deep-dive-generated forward test (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Live deep dive #5, company drawn at random (seed 20261202) from IT/software services + banks/NBFCs in the Rs 1,000-20,000 cr band (method test, L9/L21). Probability 0.05 (naive base rate 0.5) that: gross loan portfolio at 31-Mar-2027, as reported in the Q4 FY27 press release/investor presentation, is >= Rs 24,165 cr (Rs 19,332 cr at 31-Mar-2026 x 1.25). Our reasoning: H1 FY27 GLP +3.8% (19,332 -> 20,062); H2 needs +20.4% (~Rs 4,100 cr) in six months vs +3.6% in H2 FY26; the same ~25% growth guided in Nov-2025 for FY26 came out at -1.7%; JLG still shrinking. Naive base: Generic: Indian managements mostly meet numeric guidance while dates slip (L26) [EST 0.5]. Resolution: YES if gross loan portfolio at 31-Mar-2027, as reported in the Q4 FY27 press release/investor presentation, is >= Rs 24,165 cr (Rs 19,332 cr at 31-Mar-2026 x 1.25). Source: NSE Reg-30 press release / investor presentation Q4 FY27. Resolve by 2027-05-31; score with Brier vs the base rate.
